onset.Description: Start of the trial segment in the concatenated file (s); each segment covers -0.5 to 1.5 s around the outcome

sample.Description: First sample (0-based) of the trial segment

trial_index.Description: 1-based position of the trial in the released arrays

source_trial_label.Description: Value of the netCDF 'trials' coordinate for this trial, verbatim (matches the behaviour column outcome_index in the release)

PE.Description: Behaviour table column 'PE' (prediction error, as released)

outcome.Description: Behaviour table column 'outcome' (displayed outcome, e.g. '+1€', '-0€'), verbatim

outcome_time_onset.Description: Time (s) in the concatenated file of the outcome (time 0 of the segment)

outcome_time_sample.Description: Sample (0-based) of the outcome in the concatenated file
